desc: The Prodigy Compact downsizes the 1911 DS platform and enhances it with a carry-driven feature set. Available with a 3.5″ or 4.25″ bull barrel, this versatile handgun is built around a double-stack magazine and features a compact polymer grip module mounted to a lightweight billet aluminum frame. A shortened beavertail and recontoured hammer further reduce the Compact’s overall footprint.
